headline: Nigeria Economic Activity Expands for Fifth Consecutive Month
summary: Nigeria's economic activity grew marginally in October, extending its expansion for a fifth consecutive month, though rising input costs threaten the recovery.
why: Tracking economic output indicators helps investors gauge macroeconomic health and corporate earnings potential in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Continued economic expansion supports corporate revenues despite input cost pressures.
